name: PW Automatic AI Writer
author: Richard Detering

sections.description:
PW Automatic AI Writer helps you produce high-quality, in-depth, SEO-friendly content with a single click. Articles are saved as drafts—manually add images and meta descriptions before publishing. Both free and paid versions include a detailed “magical prompt” that can generate articles up to 4000 words long.

Key free-version features:
* Manual “Generate Article” button for on-demand content creation.
* Generates very long, detailed draft articles (up to ~4000 words) using the included prompt.
* Saves drafts for your review, editing, and publication.
* Compatible with WordPress ≥6.8 and PHP ≥7.0.

External services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API at https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions to generate article content. When you click Generate Article, it sends:
– Your OpenAI API key
– Your prompt text
– Model, max_tokens, and temperature settings

This service is provided by OpenAI, Inc.
– Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
– Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. In the WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New, search for “PW Automatic AI Writer,” click Install Now, then Activate.
  2. Go to Settings → AI Writer and configure:
    • OpenAI API Key
    • Manual Prompt (use the detailed example for best results)
    • OpenAI Model (recommend gpt-4o-mini)
    • Max Tokens (e.g. 12000–16000 for ~4000-word articles)
    • Stop Words (comma-separated list)
  3. Click Generate Article; drafts appear under Posts → Drafts. Review, edit, then publish as desired.
sections.faq:
Why aren’t my articles publishing automatically?

The free version only generates drafts. For automated publishing, upgrade to the Paid Version.

How long can generated articles be?

Up to ~4000 words using the included prompt and sufficient max token settings.

Can I insert images or meta descriptions automatically?

Not in the free version. You must add those manually in the editor. The paid version auto-inserts links but not images or meta descriptions.

What is the “magical prompt” and where do I find it?

A highly detailed instruction template included under Settings → Manual Prompt. Copy, adapt, and paste it into the prompt field.

How does the paid version’s subject library work?

Add topics to the library, set your desired publish interval, and the plugin auto-generates and publishes posts at that interval indefinitely.

Can the paid version run for years?

Yes; as long as you have subjects in the library, the plugin can continue publishing at your chosen interval.
